title: Dataset
description: An immutable snapshot of a curated set of files (images or annotations) selected for downstream use (annotation, model training). It references a manifest file that lists the members and links to the DatasetQuery that produced it. The dataset references file URIs; it does not copy blobs.

queryRef.description: Reference to the DatasetQuery envelope whose criteria produced this snapshot (kept separately so the same criteria can be re-run later to pull more data). May be a bare envelope id or a w3ds:// ref.

manifestRef.description: w3ds:// reference to the manifest file (a table of the member files). Content-addressed via manifestSha256.

manifestUrl.description: Convenience direct URL to the manifest file, if published.

manifestSha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the manifest content — pins the snapshot for reproducibility.

observationRefs.description: Optional inline list of the source observation ids (only for small sets; large sets live in the manifest).

frozen.description: True for an immutable snapshot (the normal case).

createdBy.description: eName of the person who saved the dataset.
